scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:server: cd apps/server && (pids=$(lsof -ti :8000 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$pids" ] && kill -9 $pids || true) && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:admin && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/server && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.lint: npm run lint:admin && npm run lint:web
